number.label: DesignVersion
number.title: Assigned design version
number.exec: if DesignVersion.val is None: DesignVersion.val = random.randint(1,12)

exec: if not p.get('outfitSession'): p.outfitSession = str(random.randint(10000000,99999999)) + str(random.randint(10000000,99999999))

block.label: OutfitRound
block.exec: p.outfitTask = int("[loopvar: task]") p.shirtOffers = outfitOffers(DesignVersion.val, p.outfitTask, 0) p.pantsOffers = outfitOffers(DesignVersion.val, p.outfitTask, 1) p.shoesOffers = outfitOffers(DesignVersion.val, p.outfitTask, 2) p.hatOffers = outfitOffers(DesignVersion.val, p.outfitTask, 3)

text.label: Offered_shirt_[loopvar: task]
text.title: Offered shirt IDs in design slot order
text.exec: Offered_shirt_[loopvar: task].val = ",".join(["shirt%s" % x for x in p.shirtOffers])

text.label: Offered_pants_[loopvar: task]

text.exec: Offered_pants_[loopvar: task].val = ",".join(["pants%s" % x for x in p.pantsOffers])
